summary: Run the seat-priority hog load test as a non-required job in the Performance workflow on pushes to main and manual dispatch.

replay.detail: Performance test addition only; no projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No writer, checkpoint, retention or authority changes.

compatibility.detail: The perf-load job, its workload, reports and baselines are unchanged; the new job is not a required check and continues on error.

downtime.detail: No service or runner deployment is introduced.

manual.detail: No manual step or workflow rerun is introduced.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the perf-load-hog job; nothing stored changes.
